whyThisFamilyNeedsARendition: All five sources carry a permissions-only /Standard handler with an empty user password. They are readable by any conforming implementation and their /P bits explicitly allow filling in form fields. pdf-lib 1.17.1 -- this repository's only PDF writer -- implements no decryption at all, so it cannot open them to write a filled artifact. The rendition exists to give pdf-lib a form of the same document it can open, and the pipeline's report is the proof that it is the same document.
geometryIsNotMeasuredHere: No rectangle in this family is measured off a rendition. reports/field-census.census-v1.json and reports/write-box-map.json are read from the official binaries, which pikepdf opens directly. The rendition is used only where pdf-lib must WRITE.
